description: A Health Check-up Camp was organised in association with the District, offering beneficiaries a range of essential health screenings, including CBC, Blood Sugar, Total Cholesterol, Vitamin B, Vitamin B12, Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH), and basic eye check-ups. Spectacles were also provided to those in need. The beneficiaries received their respective health reports at the end of the day, ensuring greater awareness of their health status and encouraging timely medical attention.
